{{Quote|Some fled. Others...Well they learned firsthand the triumph of our creation.|[[Elo Panil]], referring to the 'success' of the project|<ref name="Firefight">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>}}
A '''"super-weapon"''' was commissioned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], sometime around the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], for development on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

==Characteristics==
The creatures developed by the project were at least 6 meters tall, with thick, blaster-proof skin, that had six strong tentacles to move on, with jagged teeth along it's mouth, had a poisonous sting, and were capable of rapid movement both on land and in water. Furthermore, the creatures were designed by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to be capable of transporting prisoners via an air-tight pouch in its stomach.<ref name="Firefight" />

===Encounter With Red Squadron===
During [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron's]] mission to Kamino, one of these creatures swallowed both [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lune Oddo Divinian]] whole, transporting them to an underwater cave which served as the creatures' lair. Either this creature, or one of its identical brethren, met its match when Divinian dispatched it with Skywalker's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Skywalker and Divinian then used its air-tight stomach to attempt to swim to the surface. But were then surrounded by the bretheren of the beast before being saved by Han, Chewbacca, and R2-D2.<ref name="Firefight" />

===Encounter with Imperial Forces===
During Red Squadron's escape from Kamino, twenty or so of these creatures disabled multiple Imperial aquatic tanks, dragging them down into Kamino's depths.<ref name="Firefight" />
